feed.subtitle: Personal website of Gabriel Franco — MSc student in AI, Machine Learning and Data Science (IASD, ENS Ulm / Mines Paris / Dauphine-PSL) and ENS Paris-Saclay. Research in geometric & topological deep learning, computer vision and applied machine learning.

entry.title: Hello
entry.content:
I set up this site to collect what I work on: geometric and topological deep learning, computer vision, and the applied machine-learning projects I take on along the way.

Expect short notes — things I had to look up twice, results that surprised me, and the occasional write-up of a project once it is far enough along to be worth sharing.

Start with the about page or my CV.
entry.summary: Why this site exists and what I plan to write about.
